Join the climate change conversation. For more, visit our website https://itstimecanterbury.co.nz and Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/ItstimeCanterbury/

Whakarewarewa Forest Loop Mountain Bike Ride In Rotorua

Love mountain biking in Rotorua? One of the best things to do in Rotorua is to ride the new Whakarewarewa Forest Loop.

The Loop is a 33km circular mountain biking trail located in Whakarewarewa Forest (aka The Redwoods) just 10 minutes (by car) from the city centre of Rotorua. 

Visit https://www.rotoruanz.com/visit/whakarewarewa-forest-loop 
to find out all you need to know about this epic trail and to plan your ride!

The brand new Whakarewarewa Forest Loop is waiting for you!!!
